title: The First Computer Mouse Was Wooden
short_teaser: One of the most familiar computer tools started as a simple wooden box.
story: The first computer mouse was created in the 1960s and was made from wood. It was named because the cord looked similar to a mouse tail. One of the most familiar computer tools started as a simple wooden box. Innovation is rarely a single flash of brilliance. It is more often a chain of observations, experiments, revisions, and connections that gradually turn possibility into something useful. The lasting importance is simple: many technologies begin as simple prototypes.
impact: Many technologies begin as simple prototypes. Innovation grows when people treat imperfect results as information rather than proof that an idea should be abandoned. This matters because the lesson is transferable. It can help someone recognize a pattern, make a more thoughtful choice, or see possibility where they previously saw only a problem.
spark_application: What simple version of an idea could you create first? Choose one idea and run a tiny experiment. Decide in advance what you want to learn, not only what you hope will succeed. Afterward, save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
